The '''Imperial surveillance outpost''' was a secret outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] located in the [[Republic Research Division]] of the [[Ternion Building]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire.<ref name="TOR:RRD" />
